claim.claim-text: 1. A multimode power amplifier module, comprising a low-frequency power amplifier channel, a high-frequency power amplifier channel, a control circuit, and a transmit-receive switch, wherein

2. The multimode power amplifier module according to claim 1, wherein a drain of the transistor is connected to the ground by using the resistors (R41, R42, R43, and R44), a first gating switch is disposed between a connection point of the resistors (R41 and R42) and the positive input end of the operational amplifier, the first gating switch is conducted when Vramp<A and is closed in other cases; a second gating switch is disposed between a connection point of the resistors (R42 and R43) and the positive input end of the operational amplifier, the second gating switch is conducted when A<Vramp<B and is closed in other cases; a third gating switch is disposed between a connection point of the resistors (R43 and R44) and the positive input end of the operational amplifier, the third gating switch is conducted when Vramp>B and is closed in other cases; wherein A and B are threshold voltages.
3. A multimode power amplifier module, comprising a low-frequency power amplifier channel, a high-frequency power amplifier channel, a control circuit, and a transmit-receive switch, wherein

4. The multimode power amplifier module according to claim 3, wherein a drain of the transistor is connected to the ground by using the resistors (R31, R32, R33, and R34), a first gating switch is disposed between a connection point of the resistors (R31 and R32) and the positive input end of the operational amplifier, the first gating switch is conducted when Vramp<A and is closed in other cases; a second gating switch is disposed between a connection point of the resistors (R32 and R33) and the positive input end of the operational amplifier, the second gating switch is conducted when A<Vramp<B and is closed in other cases; a third gating switch is disposed between a connection point of the resistors (R33 and R34) and the positive input end of the operational amplifier, the third gating switch is conducted when Vramp>B and is closed in other cases; wherein A and B are threshold voltages.

5. The multimode power amplifier module according to claim 1 or 3, wherein the control circuit accesses a power supply, a baseband signal, and a working mode selection signal; the control circuit sends an amplifier control signal to the low-frequency power amplifier or the high-frequency power amplifier in accordance with the baseband signal and the working mode selection signal; the amplifier control signal includes: a logic signal, an offset signal, and/or a collector voltage.

6. The multimode power amplifier module according to claim 5, wherein in the control circuit, the baseband signal is input to a negative input end of an operational amplifier, a source of the transistor accesses a control power supply, and a drain outputs the offset signal; the offset signal accesses an offset circuit of a power amplifier.

7. The multimode power amplifier module according to claim 5, wherein in time-division multiplexing working mode, the control circuit selects a reference voltage as the basis voltage, to generate the collector voltage; the collector voltage is used to supply power to the low-frequency power amplifier or the high-frequency power amplifier, to control an output power of the low-frequency radio frequency signal or the high-frequency radio frequency signal.
8. The multimode power amplifier module according to claim 7, wherein the time-division multiplexing working mode is a TD_SCDMA and/or TDD_LTE working mode.

9. The multimode power amplifier module according to claim 1 or 3, wherein the control circuit selects a corresponding switch in an offset signal switch group according to the working mode selection signal, to generate an offset signal corresponding to a working mode; the offset signal is used to adjust a current of the low-frequency power amplifier or the high-frequency power amplifier.

10. The multimode power amplifier module according to claim 1, wherein the multi-channel analog switch has at least two channels, and opening or closing of the channels are determined by the baseband signal and the working mode.
11. A chip having a multimode power amplifier module, wherein the chip comprises the multimode power amplifier module according to any one of claims 1 to 10.
12. A communication terminal having a multimode power amplifier module, wherein the communication terminal comprises the multimode power amplifier module according to any one of claims 1 to 10.
